name: SessionRecorderWindow
src_typeComment: "Where I Left Off" — shows itself automatically after a real gap away (SessionRecorderService decides when that is), or open it anytime from the menu. Top: a note field for your own future reference — the one thing this tool can't infer on its own. Below: a timeline of what you had selected and which scripts you opened, most recent first, with a one-click jump back to each.
